item.title: [Lanka Talks] Millions of security cameras at risk: Kaspersky discovered a vulnerability in Intelbras devices
item.description: Kaspersky Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT) team has discovered a vulnerability affecting Intelbras camera systems. The flaw allows affected devices to be taken offline, creating a denial-of-service condition that prevents legitimate users from accessing live monitoring or managing the cameras.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] European Union, Sri Lanka strengthen dialogue on EU Deforestation Regulation
